kitchen.example_en: Mum is washing vegetables in the kitchen before dinner.
kitchen.example_zh: 晚饭前，妈妈正在厨房里洗蔬菜。

knee.example_en: Tom hurt his knee during football practice yesterday afternoon.
knee.example_zh: 昨天下午足球训练时，汤姆伤到了膝盖。

knickers.example_en: She packed clean knickers in her bag for the school trip.
knickers.example_zh: 她把干净的短裤装进包里，准备学校的旅行。

knife.example_en: Use this knife to slice the apples for the fruit salad.
knife.example_zh: 用这把刀把苹果切成片，做水果沙拉。

knowledge.example_en: Her knowledge of maps helped the group finish the geography task.
knowledge.example_zh: 她的地图知识帮助小组完成了地理任务。

label.example_en: Check the label on the bottle before you take any medicine.
label.example_zh: 吃药之前，先看一看瓶子上的标签。

laboratory.example_en: We heated the liquid in the laboratory during chemistry class.
laboratory.example_zh: 化学课上，我们在实验室里加热了那种液体。

labour.example_en: Farm labour starts early when the rice is ready to cut.
labour.example_zh: 稻子可以收割时，田间劳动一大早就开始了。

lad.example_en: That lad from next door walks my dog after school.
lad.example_zh: 隔壁那个小伙子放学后会遛我的狗。

ladder.example_en: Dad climbed the ladder to fix the loose roof tiles.
ladder.example_zh: 爸爸爬上梯子，去修松动的屋瓦。

lady.example_en: A lady on the bus helped my grandma carry her bags.
lady.example_zh: 公交车上一位女士帮我奶奶拎包。

lake.example_en: We swam in the lake until the sun dropped behind the hills.
lake.example_zh: 我们在湖里游泳，直到太阳落到山后面。

land.example_en: This flat land is used for growing wheat and corn.
land.example_zh: 这片平坦的土地用来种小麦和玉米。

language.example_en: Sign language helped us talk with the new student.
language.example_zh: 手语帮我们和新来的同学交流。

Latin.example_en: She is learning Latin because she loves ancient Roman stories.
Latin.example_zh: 她在学拉丁语，因为她喜欢古罗马的故事。

law.example_en: The traffic law requires bike lights after dark in our city.
law.example_zh: 交通法规定，在我们城里天黑后骑车必须亮灯。

lawyer.example_en: Our neighbour works as a lawyer in the city court.
lawyer.example_zh: 我们的邻居在市法院当律师。

layer.example_en: Spread a thin layer of butter on the warm toast.
layer.example_zh: 在热烤面包上涂一薄层黄油。

layout.example_en: The garden layout leaves space for a small football pitch.
layout.example_zh: 花园的布局给小足球场留出了空地。

leader.example_en: The group leader checked that everyone had a torch.
leader.example_zh: 组长检查了每个人是否都带了手电筒。

leadership.example_en: Her leadership kept the team calm during the close final.
leadership.example_zh: 比分接近的决赛里，她的领导让全队保持冷静。

leaf.example_en: I pressed a red leaf inside my diary from the hike.
leaf.example_zh: 我把远足时捡的一片红叶夹进了日记。

leaflet.example_en: A volunteer handed me a leaflet at the weekend book sale.
leaflet.example_zh: 周末售书时，一位志愿者递给我一张宣传单。

league.example_en: Our school joined a football league with four nearby towns.
league.example_zh: 我们学校和附近四个城镇一起参加了足球联盟。

learning.example_en: Remote learning continued while the roads were blocked by snow.
learning.example_zh: 道路被雪堵住时，远程学习仍在继续。

lecturer.example_en: A university lecturer described college life in the assembly hall.
lecturer.example_zh: 一位大学讲师在礼堂里介绍了大学生活。

left.example_en: Keep to the left when you cycle through the school gate.
left.example_zh: 骑车进校门时请靠左边走。

leg.example_en: He wrapped a bandage around his leg after the fall.
leg.example_zh: 摔倒之后，他在腿上缠了绷带。

legislation.example_en: New safety legislation requires helmets on every building site.
legislation.example_zh: 新的安全法规要求每个建筑工地都戴头盔。

leisure.example_en: She spends her leisure reading novels in the garden.
leisure.example_zh: 她有空的时候就在花园里看小说。

lemon.example_en: I squeezed a lemon over the fish Mum grilled for lunch.
lemon.example_zh: 我在妈妈午饭烤的鱼上挤了一个柠檬。

length.example_en: The length of the pool is marked on the wall tiles.
length.example_zh: 泳池的长度标在墙面的瓷砖上。

lesson.example_en: My violin lesson was moved to Wednesday after school.
lesson.example_zh: 我的小提琴课改到了星期三放学以后。

letter.example_en: The letter from my pen friend arrived on a rainy day.
letter.example_zh: 笔友的信在一个下雨天送到了。

level.example_en: Her English level rose after she joined the reading club.
level.example_zh: 她加入阅读社团之后，英语水平提高了。

licence.example_en: You need a driving licence to rent a car here.
licence.example_zh: 在这里租车需要驾驶执照。

license.example_en: The restaurant lost its license after the health inspection.
license.example_zh: 卫生检查之后，这家餐馆的执照被吊销了。

life.example_en: Village life moves slowly, and neighbours still share vegetables.
life.example_zh: 乡村生活节奏很慢，邻居们仍会分享蔬菜。

lifestyle.example_en: His lifestyle changed when he started cycling to work.
lifestyle.example_zh: 他开始骑自行车上班以后，生活方式变了。

light.example_en: Early light came through the curtains and woke the baby.
light.example_zh: 清晨的光透过窗帘，把宝宝弄醒了。

lighting.example_en: Better lighting in the stairwell made the evenings feel safer.
lighting.example_zh: 楼梯间的光线更好了，晚上感觉更安全。

line.example_en: Draw a straight line under the title of your essay.
line.example_zh: 在作文标题下面画一条直线。

link.example_en: Click the link on the school site to see the bus times.
link.example_zh: 点击学校网站上的链接，就能看到校车时间。

lip.example_en: Hot soup burned her lip, so she drank some cold water.
lip.example_zh: 热汤烫了她的嘴唇，于是她喝了点凉水。

list.example_en: Dad read the list aloud while we packed the picnic basket.
list.example_zh: 我们装野餐篮时，爸爸大声念着清单。

literature.example_en: She prefers literature to science when she chooses library books.
literature.example_zh: 在图书馆挑书时，她更喜欢文学而不是科学。

litre.example_en: The recipe needs a litre of milk and two eggs.
litre.example_zh: 这个食谱需要一升牛奶和两个鸡蛋。

living.example_en: City living can be noisy, but the shops stay open late.
living.example_zh: 城市生活可能很吵，但商店会开到很晚。

loads.example_en: Extra loads on the ferry made it sit lower in the water.
loads.example_zh: 渡轮上额外的负荷让船身在水里沉得更低。

loaf.example_en: Mum sliced the loaf and made cheese sandwiches for the trip.
loaf.example_zh: 妈妈把那条面包切片，做了旅行时吃的奶酪三明治。

loan.example_en: They repaid the loan early after selling the old flat.
loan.example_zh: 卖掉旧公寓以后，他们提前还清了贷款。

location.example_en: Share your location with Dad when you change buses downtown.
location.example_zh: 在市区换乘公交时，把你的位置发给爸爸。

London.example_en: We changed trains in London on our way to the coast.
London.example_zh: 去海边的路上，我们在伦敦换了火车。

loss.example_en: The loss of two players weakened our team before the final.
loss.example_zh: 两名队员的损失让我们队在决赛前变弱了。

luck.example_en: She was in luck and found a seat on the crowded bus.
luck.example_zh: 她运气不错，在拥挤的公交车上找到了座位。

lunch.example_en: We shared lunch on the grass behind the science block.
lunch.example_zh: 我们在科学楼后面的草地上一起吃了午餐。

machine.example_en: This ticket machine only takes coins, not paper notes.
machine.example_zh: 这台售票机只收硬币，不收纸币。

magazine.example_en: I borrowed a cooking magazine from the school library.
magazine.example_zh: 我从学校图书馆借了一本烹饪杂志。

mail.example_en: The afternoon mail included a birthday card from my aunt.
mail.example_zh: 下午的邮件里有姑姑寄来的生日贺卡。

maintenance.example_en: Winter maintenance of the pitch starts when the season ends.
maintenance.example_zh: 赛季一结束，球场的冬季保养就开始了。

majority.example_en: A majority voted to keep the school uniform next year.
majority.example_zh: 大多数人投票赞成明年继续穿校服。

maker.example_en: The violin maker let us watch him shape a new instrument.
maker.example_zh: 小提琴制造者让我们看他制作一件新乐器。

man.example_en: A tall man held the door open for the children.
man.example_zh: 一位高个子男人为孩子们撑着门。

management.example_en: Poor management caused long queues at the ticket window.
management.example_zh: 管理不善，售票窗口排起了长队。

manager.example_en: The shop manager gave us a discount on the team shirts.
manager.example_zh: 商店经理给我们的队服打了折。

manner.example_en: He greeted the guests in a friendly manner at the door.
manner.example_zh: 他在门口以友好的样子迎接客人。

manufacturer.example_en: A local manufacturer supplies desks to schools in the county.
manufacturer.example_zh: 当地一家制造商给全县的学校供应课桌。

manufacturing.example_en: Toy manufacturing employs hundreds of people in this town.
manufacturing.example_zh: 玩具制造业雇用了这座镇上的几百人。

March.example_en: Snow still covered the playground in early March this year.
March.example_zh: 今年三月初，操场上还盖着雪。

market.example_en: We bought strawberries at the market on the way home.
market.example_zh: 回家路上，我们在市场买了草莓。

marketing.example_en: Clever marketing made the new juice popular at school.
marketing.example_zh: 巧妙的市场营销让这种新果汁在学校很受欢迎。

marriage.example_en: Their long marriage began when they were university classmates.
marriage.example_zh: 他们长久的婚姻从大学同学时期就开始了。

master.example_en: The chess master played three games with our club after lunch.
master.example_zh: 午饭后，这位国际象棋大师和我们俱乐部下了三盘。

mat.example_en: Please wipe your feet on the mat outside the front door.
mat.example_zh: 请在前门外面的垫子上擦擦鞋。

mate.example_en: She introduced her mate to her parents over Sunday lunch.
mate.example_zh: 星期天午饭时，她把配偶介绍给了父母。

material.example_en: Wool is a warm material for coats in the northern winter.
material.example_zh: 羊毛是北方冬天做大衣的保暖材料。

matter.example_en: The missing money is a serious matter for the class fund.
matter.example_zh: 钱不见了，这对班费来说是件严重的事情。

May.example_en: Exams finish in May, and then the sports meeting begins.
May.example_zh: 考试在五月结束，接着运动会就开始了。

meal.example_en: Dinner is the only meal our whole family eats together.
meal.example_zh: 晚饭是我们全家唯一在一起吃的一餐。

meaning.example_en: I still do not understand the meaning of the last line.
meaning.example_zh: 我还是不明白最后一行的意思。

means.example_en: The ferry is the only means of reaching the island school.
means.example_zh: 渡船是去岛上那所学校的唯一手段。

measure.example_en: One safety measure is keeping bags out of the aisle.
measure.example_zh: 一项安全措施是不把书包放在过道里。

measurement.example_en: Take one measurement of the window before ordering curtains.
measurement.example_zh: 订窗帘之前，先给窗户量一下尺寸。

meat.example_en: We grilled meat in the yard for my father's birthday.
meat.example_zh: 爸爸过生日时，我们在院子里烤了肉。

mechanism.example_en: Sand jammed the mechanism of the old classroom clock.
mechanism.example_zh: 沙子卡住了教室那座旧钟的机制。

media.example_en: The local media reported our team's win on the evening news.
media.example_zh: 当地媒体在晚间新闻里报道了我们队获胜。

medicine.example_en: The bitter medicine worked, and her fever fell by evening.
medicine.example_zh: 这苦药起了作用，到傍晚她的烧退了。

Mediterranean.example_en: They sailed across the Mediterranean during the summer holiday.
Mediterranean.example_zh: 暑假里，他们乘船穿过了地中海。

meeting.example_en: The team meeting ended early because the coach was ill.
meeting.example_zh: 教练病了，所以队会提前结束了。

membership.example_en: Annual membership lets you borrow ten books at a time.
membership.example_zh: 有了年度会员资格，一次可以借十本书。

memory.example_en: The smell of rain brings back a memory of my first camp.
memory.example_zh: 雨的气味让我想起第一次露营的记忆。

menu.example_en: Nothing on the menu looked familiar except rice and eggs.
menu.example_zh: 菜单上除了米饭和鸡蛋，别的都不眼熟。

mess.example_en: Paint left a mess on the floor of the art room.
mess.example_zh: 颜料把美术教室的地板弄得一片混乱。

metal.example_en: The gate is made of metal and rattles in strong wind.
metal.example_zh: 大门是金属做的，大风时会哗啦作响。

method.example_en: Her method is to read the questions before the passage.
method.example_zh: 她的方法是先读题目，再读文章。

metre.example_en: Stand one metre away from the person in front of you.
metre.example_zh: 和前面的人保持一公尺的距离。

Mexico.example_en: The football final was played in Mexico late last night.
Mexico.example_zh: 足球决赛于昨晚深夜在墨西哥举行。

microphone.example_en: Tap the microphone if the back row cannot hear you.
microphone.example_zh: 如果后排听不清，就敲一下麦克风。

middle.example_en: Our seats were in the middle, close to the aisle.
middle.example_zh: 我们的座位在中间，靠近过道。

mile.example_en: The stadium is half a mile from the nearest bus stop.
mile.example_zh: 体育场离最近的公交车站有半英里。

milk.example_en: Hot milk and bread are my usual breakfast on school days.
milk.example_zh: 热牛奶加面包是我上学日通常的早餐。

mind.example_en: The tune stayed in my mind long after the concert ended.
mind.example_zh: 音乐会结束很久了，那首曲子还留在我的头脑里。

minister.example_en: The health minister promised more nurses for rural clinics.
minister.example_zh: 卫生部长答应给乡村诊所增加护士。

minority.example_en: A minority wanted extra homework, but most students refused.
minority.example_zh: 只有少数人想要额外作业，大多数学生都拒绝了。

minute.example_en: Give me a minute to tie my shoes before we run.
minute.example_zh: 跑步前给我一分钟，我系一下鞋带。

mission.example_en: Our mission was to collect books for the village school.
mission.example_zh: 我们的使命是为那所乡村学校募集图书。

mistake.example_en: One spelling mistake cost him a mark on the dictation.
mistake.example_zh: 一个拼写错误让他在听写里丢了一分。

mix.example_en: Stir the mix until the flour disappears into the milk.
mix.example_zh: 把混合料搅拌到面粉完全融进牛奶里。

mixture.example_en: Pour the mixture into the tin and bake it for twenty minutes.
mixture.example_zh: 把混合物倒进烤盘，烤二十分钟。

mode.example_en: Silent mode kept his phone quiet during the whole film.
mode.example_zh: 静音模式让他的手机在整场电影里都没有出声。

model.example_en: The clay model of the volcano cracked while it was drying.
model.example_zh: 火山的黏土模型在晾干时裂开了。

module.example_en: The final module covers essays, speeches, and short stories.
module.example_zh: 最后一个模块包括作文、演讲和短篇故事。

moment.example_en: For a moment nobody spoke after the captain scored.
moment.example_zh: 队长进球之后，有那么一会儿谁都没有说话。

Monday.example_en: The library stays closed on Monday because of staff training.
Monday.example_zh: 因为员工培训，图书馆星期一不开放。

money.example_en: Count your money before you pay for the train ticket.
money.example_zh: 买火车票之前，先把钱数清楚。

month.example_en: This month has five weekends, so we planned two picnics.
month.example_zh: 这个月有五个周末，所以我们安排了两次野餐。

mood.example_en: Winning the relay put the whole class in a happy mood.
mood.example_zh: 接力赛赢了以后，全班的心情都很好。

moon.example_en: We could see the moon above the rooftops after supper.
moon.example_zh: 晚饭后，我们能看见屋顶上方的月亮。

morning.example_en: A foggy morning delayed the school bus by twenty minutes.
morning.example_zh: 有雾的早晨让校车晚点了二十分钟。

mother.example_en: His mother woke him early for the trip to the museum.
mother.example_zh: 他母亲一早就叫醒他，好去博物馆。

motion.example_en: The gentle motion of the train soon put the baby to sleep.
motion.example_zh: 火车轻轻的晃动很快让宝宝睡着了。

motor.example_en: Salt water damaged the motor of our small fishing boat.
motor.example_zh: 咸水损坏了我们那艘小渔船的发动机。

motorway.example_en: Traffic on the motorway was slow because of the heavy rain.
motorway.example_zh: 因为大雨，高速公路上的车开得很慢。

mouse.example_en: Our cat chased a mouse across the kitchen late at night.
mouse.example_zh: 深夜，我们的猫在厨房里追一只老鼠。

mouth.example_en: He burned his mouth on the hot dumpling and reached for water.
mouth.example_zh: 热饺子烫到了他的嘴，他连忙去拿水。

movement.example_en: Any movement in the bushes made the rabbits run away.
movement.example_zh: 灌木丛里只要有动静，兔子就跑开了。

movie.example_en: The movie ended so late that we missed the last bus.
movie.example_zh: 电影结束得太晚，我们错过了末班车。

mug.example_en: I left my mug on the windowsill and the tea went cold.
mug.example_zh: 我把杯子落在窗台上，茶都凉了。

mummy.example_en: The child would not sleep unless his mummy sat beside him.
mummy.example_zh: 除非妈妈坐在旁边，不然这个孩子不肯睡觉。

murder.example_en: The play ends with a murder, so younger pupils should not watch.
murder.example_zh: 这出戏以一场谋杀结束，低年级学生不适合看。

muscle.example_en: Daily swimming built muscle in his arms and back.
muscle.example_zh: 每天游泳让他的手臂和背部长出了肌肉。

museum.example_en: Our history class spent the afternoon at the city museum.
museum.example_zh: 我们历史课的那个下午是在市博物馆度过的。

mushroom.example_en: A wild mushroom grew beside the path after three rainy days.
mushroom.example_zh: 连着下了三天雨以后，小路边长出了一朵野蘑菇。

music.example_en: Loud music from next door made it hard to do homework.
music.example_zh: 隔壁的音乐声很大，作业很难写下去。

musician.example_en: The musician tuned his guitar before the school concert.
musician.example_zh: 学校音乐会开始前，那位音乐家给吉他调了音。

Muslim.example_en: My neighbour is a Muslim and prepares a special meal when Ramadan ends.
Muslim.example_zh: 我的邻居是穆斯林，斋月结束时会准备一顿特别的饭。

mystery.example_en: The missing cake was a mystery until my brother confessed.
mystery.example_zh: 蛋糕失踪一直是个秘密，直到我弟弟承认是他拿的。

name.example_en: Write your full name clearly on the cover of the notebook.
name.example_zh: 把你的全名清楚地写在笔记本封面上。

nation.example_en: People across the nation watched the final on television.
nation.example_zh: 全国各地的人都在电视上看了决赛。

nature.example_en: Camping lets children see nature away from busy streets.
nature.example_zh: 露营能让孩子们离开热闹的街道，看见自然。

neck.example_en: The scarf slipped from her neck when she ran for the bus.
neck.example_zh: 她追公交车时，围巾从脖子上滑了下来。

net.example_en: Our best shot hit the net and never reached the goal.
net.example_zh: 我们最好的一脚打在网上，球没有进。

Netherlands.example_en: Cheese from the Netherlands was served at the food fair.
Netherlands.example_zh: 食品展上供应了来自荷兰的奶酪。

network.example_en: A weak network stopped the video call with our sister school.
network.example_zh: 网络太差，和姐妹学校的视频通话中断了。

news.example_en: Good news arrived: our school team reached the city final.
news.example_zh: 好消息来了：我们校队进入了市决赛。

newsletter.example_en: The sports newsletter named the players chosen for Saturday.
newsletter.example_zh: 体育简讯公布了星期六入选的队员。

newspaper.example_en: He folded the newspaper and caught the bus to work.
newspaper.example_zh: 他叠好报纸，赶上了去上班的公交车。

night.example_en: The night was cold, so we stayed inside the tent.
night.example_zh: 黑天很冷，所以我们待在帐篷里面。

noise.example_en: Traffic noise kept me awake until the streets grew quiet.
noise.example_zh: 车辆噪音让我一直醒着，直到街上安静下来。

north.example_en: The windows face the north, so the room stays cool in summer.
north.example_zh: 窗户朝向北面，所以夏天房间很凉快。

Norway.example_en: My cousin in Norway sent a photo of deep winter snow.
Norway.example_zh: 我在挪威的表哥寄来一张隆冬大雪的照片。

nose.example_en: Cold air made his nose red during the morning run.
nose.example_zh: 晨跑时，冷空气把他的鼻子冻红了。

note.example_en: I copied the formula into a note and stuck it on my desk.
note.example_zh: 我把公式抄进笔记，贴在了课桌上。

notice.example_en: The notice asks runners to arrive thirty minutes early.
notice.example_zh: 通知要求跑步的人提前三十分钟到达。

November.example_en: Leaves cover the path in November after the first strong wind.
November.example_zh: 十一月第一场大风过后，小路上铺满了落叶。

number.example_en: The number of bikes outside the gate doubles after school.
number.example_zh: 放学以后，校门外自行车的数目会增加一倍。

nurse.example_en: The nurse cleaned the cut and told him to rest.
nurse.example_zh: 护士清洗了伤口，让他休息。

nut.example_en: Squirrels hid every nut they found under the oak tree.
nut.example_zh: 松鼠把找到的每一颗坚果都藏到了橡树下面。

object.example_en: An unusual object washed up on the beach after the storm.
object.example_zh: 暴风雨过后，一件奇怪的物体被冲上了海滩。

observation.example_en: Her observation of the moon filled three pages of her diary.
observation.example_zh: 她对月亮的观测写满了日记里的三页。

occupation.example_en: Nursing became her occupation after years of hospital work.
occupation.example_zh: 在医院工作多年以后，护理成了她的职业。

October.example_en: We pick apples in October and bake them on Sunday.
October.example_zh: 我们十月摘苹果，星期天把它们烤着吃。

offence.example_en: Dropping litter in the park is an offence in our town.
offence.example_zh: 在我们镇上，往公园里乱扔垃圾是一种冒犯。

offering.example_en: The villagers left an offering of flowers at the old shrine.
offering.example_zh: 村民们在旧神龛前留下了鲜花作为供品。

office.example_en: Mum called from the office to say she would be late.
office.example_zh: 妈妈从办公室打来电话，说她会晚一点到。

officer.example_en: The officer inspected the tents before the night march began.
officer.example_zh: 夜行军开始前，军官检查了帐篷。

oil.example_en: Dad's factory uses oil to heat the workshops in winter.
oil.example_zh: 冬天，爸爸的工厂用石油给车间供暖。

opening.example_en: The opening of the speech was a joke about school lunch.
opening.example_zh: 演讲的开始是一个关于学校午餐的笑话。

operation.example_en: Doctors said the operation would take about two hours.
operation.example_zh: 医生说这个手术大约需要两个小时。

operator.example_en: The radio operator sent our location when the boat stalled.
operator.example_zh: 船停住以后，无线电操作员发出了我们的位置。

opinion.example_en: My opinion is that the later bus is safer after dark.
opinion.example_zh: 我的观点是，天黑以后坐晚一点的车更安全。

opportunity.example_en: The contest is a good opportunity to show your speaking skills.
opportunity.example_zh: 这次比赛是展示你口语能力的好机会。

opposition.example_en: Strong opposition from parents saved the small village school.
opposition.example_zh: 家长的强烈反对保住了那所乡村小学。

option.example_en: Staying home was the safer option during the heavy snow.
option.example_zh: 下大雪时，待在家里是更安全的选择。

organisation.example_en: The aid organisation brought clean water to the flooded streets.
organisation.example_zh: 援助组织给被淹的街道送来了干净的水。

origin.example_en: The origin of this custom is a harvest feast long ago.
origin.example_zh: 这个习俗的起源是很久以前的一场收获宴。

outcome.example_en: We waited nervously for the outcome of the singing contest.
outcome.example_zh: 我们紧张地等待歌唱比赛的结果。

output.example_en: The bakery's output of bread rises before the Spring Festival.
output.example_zh: 春节前，这家面包店的面包产量会上升。

oven.example_en: Take the bread out of the oven before it turns too brown.
oven.example_zh: 趁面包还没变得太黄，把它从烤箱里拿出来。

pace.example_en: He kept a steady pace and finished the cross-country run.
pace.example_zh: 他保持稳定的步伐，跑完了越野赛。

Pacific.example_en: Huge waves in the Pacific delayed the cargo ship for days.
Pacific.example_zh: 太平洋上的巨浪把货船耽搁了好几天。

pack.example_en: She split a pack of crayons with her younger sister.
pack.example_zh: 她和妹妹合用了一包蜡笔。

packet.example_en: A packet of tea fell out of the shopping bag on the bus.
packet.example_zh: 在公交车上，一小袋茶叶从购物袋里掉了出来。

page.example_en: The answer key is on the last page of the workbook.
page.example_zh: 参考答案在练习册的最后一页。

pain.example_en: Sudden pain in his shoulder made him stop swimming.
pain.example_zh: 肩膀突然疼痛，他只好停止游泳。

painting.example_en: His painting of our street hangs in the town library.
painting.example_zh: 他画我们这条街的那幅画挂在镇图书馆里。

pair.example_en: I need a new pair of trainers before basketball season starts.
pair.example_zh: 篮球赛季开始前，我需要一双新运动鞋。

Pakistan.example_en: A student from Pakistan joined our class at the start of term.
Pakistan.example_zh: 学期初，一名来自巴基斯坦的学生加入了我们班。

panel.example_en: Press the green button on the panel to start the printer.
panel.example_zh: 按下面板上的绿色按钮，就能启动打印机。

paper.example_en: I wrapped the glass in paper so it would not break.
paper.example_zh: 我用纸把玻璃杯包好，免得它碎掉。

paragraph.example_en: Delete the second paragraph if the essay is too long.
paragraph.example_zh: 如果作文太长，就删掉第二段。

parcel.example_en: The parcel was damaged, but the books inside were fine.
parcel.example_zh: 包裹破损了，不过里面的书还是完好的。

parent.example_en: Ask a parent to sign the form before Friday's museum visit.
parent.example_zh: 星期五参观博物馆之前，请一位家长在表格上签字。
